name: context-heads-up
description: Tells each thread when its context passes set shares of the model's window: the main thread to compact at a pause, a sub-agent to wrap up and hand back

headsUpPercent.title: Heads-up at (% of window)
headsUpPercent.description: Share of the model's context window at which a thread gets its first note: the main thread to look for a pause to compact, a sub-agent to wrap up.

overduePercent.title: Overdue at (% of window)
overduePercent.description: Share of the window at which a thread gets the overdue note.

ceilingPercent.title: Never past (% of window)
ceilingPercent.description: The ceiling the main thread's overdue note names as the point never to pass.
